column4: toolchain-gated: cleat#1981's Python start-input fixture builds a real component with componentize-py, which THIS job does not install. Python is tier 1, and its toolchain is provisioned by the tier-1 Gate's rest shard (scripts/tier-gate.sh refuses to run at all without componentize-py and wasm-tools) and by e2e-cross-language.yml -- not by test-go/commands. The gate is legitimate rather than convenient: the test calls t.Fatalf, not t.Skip, when CLEAT_REQUIRE_TOOLCHAINS names python, so a job that PROMISES the toolchain cannot silently skip this. Measured by name, with no CLEAT_TEST_* set (the fixture's store is a mock, so it needs no database): go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run '^TestARealPythonFixtureWorkflowValidatesStartInput$' -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly 1. Its Go sibling TestARealGoFixtureWorkflowValidatesStartInput skips only under -short, which test-go/commands does not pass, so it is not charged here.
